candidates.title: The ask cap does not hold: a question spends past OPENFERMENT_ASK_BUDGET_USD by up to one held-back answer turn, and a zero budget still makes two calls
candidates.statement: Each round's ceiling is sized to spend all the budget left after the conversation is read, so the final MIN_TOKENS answer the loop holds back is paid for past the cap: at the default 0.75 USD a question whose turns write their whole room spends 0.91 USD, at 2.00 it spends 2.16, and at 0 it makes two model calls costing 0.52.
candidates.contract: ADR-008 6.3 (docs/decisions/ADR-008-postdoc-memory-routing.md:101-102) "the loop stops asking for tools when what it spent and what the answer could cost reach the question's budget, so the answer is paid for within it"; postdoc_agent.py:545-546 "so the answer is always paid for within the question's budget"; ADR-008 Implementation 9 (line 150) "The ask's cost cap (OPENFERMENT_ASK_BUDGET_USD) bounds what one question spends"
candidates.reproCommand: OPENFERMENT_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://openferment:openferment@127.0.0.1:5432/bh_h9_spend OPENFERMENT_ROUTES= core/.venv/bin/python bughunt/notes/H9/scripts/ask_budget.py (from core/, keyless, after bh_db_fresh bh_h9_spend)
candidates.expected: The question's total cost at or under the ask budget whenever each turn costs at most what its max_tokens allows (the stand-in charges input at four characters a token and every output token the turn allows).
candidates.observed: budget 0: 2 turns, 0.5236 USD; budget 0.75: turns (auto, 27360 tokens, 0.6487) then (none, 8000, 0.2620), 0.9108 USD; budget 2.00: 4 turns, 2.1607 USD; each stopped 'cost'.
candidates.cause: core/openferment_core/postdoc_agent.py:537-540 `left = budget_usd - run.spent.costUsd - read` gives a round every dollar left without keeping back _final_turn_usd; _out_of_budget (called at :597) stops only after the round has spent it, and the final turn (:600-604) then runs at MIN_TOKENS whatever is left; the first turn runs at MIN_TOKENS with no check at all, so a zero budget still calls twice.
candidates.evidence: ask_budget.py drives postdoc_agent.ask with a stand-in converse and one cheap tool (study_read) on a bh_h9_spend project; bughunt/notes/H9/evidence/ask_budget.txt.
